senses.gloss: बडवा- + अनल बडवा- + अनल, m. submarine fire, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 419.

बडवा बडवा and वडवा, f.
 1. A [] mare, Pañc. 252, 16; Utt. Rāmac. 123, 1.
 2. The nymph Aśvinī, or the personified asterism which is designated by a horse's head, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 11.
 3. A female slave, Rājat. 5, 280 (cf. -अनल).

बाडव बाडव (also वाडव), i. e. बडवा + अ,
 I. m.
 1. A Brāhmaṇa.
 2. Submarine fire, Pañc. iv. d. 26.
 II. n. A stud.
† बाड् बाड्, or वाड् वाड्, i. 1, Ātm. To bathe, to dive and emerge.
बडवा- + मुख बडवा- + मुख, m. submarine fire.
